name: cache-clock
description: Shows a countdown to prompt-cache expiry above the prompt, can keep the cache warm with cheap background pings, and suggests a fresh chat with a handoff when a big chat has gone cold.

ttlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after the last model response. 0 (default) detects it from the API and assumes 5 minutes when nothing says otherwise; set 5 or 60 to override.

minTokens.title: Minimum context (tokens)
minTokens.description: The band stays hidden while the chat holds fewer tokens than this.

handoffTokens.title: Handoff offer threshold (tokens)
handoffTokens.description: When the cache has gone cold and the chat holds at least this many tokens, offer a fresh chat with a handoff summary.

maxPings.title: Max keep-warm pings per idle stretch
maxPings.description: Upper bound on background pings between two of your turns.

keepWarmDefault.title: Keep warm on by default
keepWarmDefault.description: Start each session with Keep warm switched on. Pings cost tokens, so this is off unless you choose it.
